terminal.follow: {{state}} · progress shows here as it goes; once the terminal is closed, carry on here

run.quiet: Still running · no new output for {{n}} min

idle.before: The prompt cache expires in about {{minutes}} min. Compacting now reads the cache, far cheaper than compacting after it expires (context about {{size}}).
idle.after: {{span}} since the last turn, so the prompt cache has expired: the next message rereads about {{size}} of context at full price. For a new task, start a new session (like /clear); to go on more cheaply, switch to a cheaper model to compact, then switch back.

tool.backgroundHint: The command keeps running and Claude moves on without waiting; Claude gets the result when it ends
tool.endHint: Ends just this one; the turn goes on and Claude carries on

note.planMode: Claude entered plan mode: it researches and writes a plan, and acts only once you approve

mode.label: Approval mode
mode.question: How should Claude Code ask before acting?

auto.name: Auto approval
auto.detail: Claude Code judges the risk and asks only when needed

default.name: Manual approval
default.detail: Asks before editing files and running commands

acceptEdits.name: Accept edits
acceptEdits.detail: File edits go through; commands still ask first

plan.name: Plan mode
plan.detail: Only researches and writes a plan; acts once you approve

bypassPermissions.name: Bypass permissions
bypassPermissions.detail: Never asks about anything, at your own risk

bypass.label: Confirm bypassing permissions
bypass.question: Bypass permissions?
bypass.warning: In this session Claude will do anything without asking, including deleting files and running any command on your computer, until you switch back to another approval mode. Use it only where you can bear the consequences.

plan.label: Claude's plan
plan.title: Plan
plan.feedbackHint: Say what to change and Claude will keep planning with it (optional)
plan.modeLabel: Approval mode for carrying it out

link.webHint: Click to confirm and open · {{key}} + click opens at once · right-click to copy the address
link.pathHint: Click to open · right-click for more

background.title: Background tasks · Claude has answered and carries on once they end
background.count_one: {{count}} background task · Claude has answered and carries on once it ends
background.count_other: {{count}} background tasks · Claude has answered and carries on once they end
background.locked: Until the tasks end, the model, effort and approval mode can't be changed, and the session can't be renamed, forked or edited and resent.
background.lockedSend: Until the tasks end, the model, effort and approval mode can't be changed, and the session can't be renamed, forked or edited and resent; messages can be sent as usual.

approval.safetyHint: Claude Code's own safety check, which asks in every approval mode

message.terminalHint: Asked in a terminal; recorded in this session as the terminal goes on
message.editUnsent: Edit and resend: this message never reached Claude Code, so it goes back into this session's input box, without a fork
message.editFork: Edit and resend: forks a new session from before this message; this one is kept

history.earlierFailed: Couldn't load earlier messages, try again
